records: Circle Mint minted/redeemed values are primary-market fiat conversions initiated by Circle Mint customers, not all USDC issuance, secondary-market transfers, on-chain volume, or total stablecoin market capital flows. Q2/H1 net mint-minus-redemption is derived from gross values. Coinbase-agreement distribution costs divided by Circle's total distribution, transaction and other costs (78.7% Q2; 80.0% H1) are derived expense ratios, not Coinbase's share of USDC balances or all distributor payouts. Neither series establishes XRP purchases or collateral demand.
